peopleAlsoAsk.question: Which sports are the best for improving bone density?
peopleAlsoAsk.snippet: If you want to build healthy bones, the best thing you can do is make an impact with the ground. In other words, try running, jumping, or walking. These activities create forces that move through your bones and help with the bone remodeling process that adds density.
peopleAlsoAsk.title: Bone Density and Weight-Bearing Exercise

peopleAlsoAsk.question: Why do 70% of kids quit sports?
What types of exercises can help strengthen bones in children and adolescents?
peopleAlsoAsk.snippet: Activities like walking, running, jumping, and climbing are especially good for building bone. They are called weight-bearing activities because they use the force of our muscles and gravity to put pressure on our bones. The pressure makes the body build up stronger bone.
peopleAlsoAsk.title: 3 Ways to Build Strong Bones | Nemours KidsHealth

peopleAlsoAsk.question: Does flexibility training increase bone density?
peopleAlsoAsk.snippet: Strength and flexibility exercises will help you increase muscle strength, maintain bone density, improve balance and reduce joint pain.
